title: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:34869:20240903:00016:part:1/1
title_original: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 34869, September 3, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Applicability concerning Payment of Members' Allowances)
The amended provisions of Article 2 (1) shall apply beginning with the allowances payable for September 2024.
